skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, then heals self for 120% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK DMG to the target's row. Grants [Superspeed] to self and up to 6 other allies; while [Superspeed] is active, allies whose SPD beats the target deal an extra 500% ATK DMG when they attack. Own row-mates gain SPD when their SPD exceeds the target's (SPD check at 92%). If the target has Energy, drains it (3x Energy DMG) and applies [Energy Cut] to all enemies when their Energy drops.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 80% > 120% ATK DMG to the target's row. Grants [Superspeed] to self and up to 6 other allies; while [Superspeed] is active, allies whose SPD beats the target deal an extra 500% ATK DMG when they attack. Own row-mates gain SPD when their SPD exceeds the target's (SPD check at 92% > 96%). If the target has Energy, drains it (3x > 5x Energy DMG) and applies [Energy Cut] to all enemies when their Energy drops. Additionally restores 1000 Energy to self.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Before battle begins, [Encourage] allies. 100% chance to use its own Ultimate skill to attack the target with [Specialized Burn].[Encourage]: gain an additional 2 Energy at the beginning of the round for 3 rounds.[Specialized Burn]: 150% ATK in continuous DMG; disappears after activating 3 times; transfers to a target that can take damage after any character moves.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of the battle, grants [Specialized Acceleration] (Increases SPD by 25%, if the main target's SPD is lower than Sonic, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG). Permanently grants himself 65% chance of [Evasion] (Reduce Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1 DMG)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Increase SPD 25% > 30% Evasion > + allies in the same row @ 45% chance
